}}'''Comarra Zepava''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|244}} and served in that capacity until {{Ne|276}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Comarra Zepava}}

==History==
Comarra held the position for thirty-two years until her death in {{Ne|276}}. She was [[Elise Strang]]'s successor and [[Serenia Latar]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Comarra was a moderately strong Amyrlin.
